description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Sooriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District  (7821)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It specifically addresses amendments to land title registrations for specific parcels of land, including cadastral map references, location details, and the expunging of particulars. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters without any government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
